named_objects: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali

observations.statement: Italian data-protection and labour authorities opened joint inspections of Amazon logistics centres concerning surveillance systems and worker rights.
The public decision describes an internal platform linked to attendance that prompted or supported return-from-absence interviews.
Managers entered free-text notes that included health conditions, strike and union activity, family matters, and alleged leave misuse.
The authority reported that the information accumulated over time, was accessible to multiple managers, and could be retained for years after employment.
Four cameras near worker-only bathroom and break-area access points were included in the immediate limitation.
The authority ordered immediate definitive limitations on specified processing while the broader investigation remained open.

title: Amazon Italia Logistica sensitive worker profiling and immediate processing prohibition
